name: TinyFish

modes.label: Native product meter; not a general-purpose 4-vCPU/8-GiB VM
modes.note: Browser $0.002/browser-minute ($0.12/h), Agent $0.016/step (LLM included; default max 150 steps/run = $2.40 cap; 10-min run timeout), Monitor $0.005/completed run, Search/Fetch free. Browser sessions end only on DELETE or after an inactivity timeout (plan max 15 min free / 60 min paid; configurable 5-86400 s); session creation takes 10-30 s. No vCPU/RAM published; sizes intentionally empty.

modes.label: Monitor (Page/Topic change tracking)
modes.note: $0.005 per completed run from the Wallet; failed runs free; email/webhook/change detection included; Topic Monitors at most every 30 min.

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.note: Prepaid Wallet (min top-up $10, optional auto-reload). Browser 5 concurrent sessions; Agent 2 concurrent runs; Search 30/min & 500/h; Fetch 150 URLs/min & 1,000/day; no subscription, seats or monthly minimum. Browser inactivity timeout max 60 min (15 min on free tier). Limits raised only via sales.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom concurrency and rate limits; ISO 27001; Enterprise SSO; audit logs; VPC deployment; 99.99% uptime SLA; contract.

plans.name: Legacy credit plan
plans.note: Older subscription/credit accounts: 1 credit per Agent step and 1 credit per 4 browser-minutes; rates in account dashboard. Not sold to new accounts.

free.note: $8 one-time Wallet funds for new accounts (no card); Search and Fetch free forever within rate limits at any Wallet balance. Minimum deposit afterwards $10.

features.ip_note: proxy_config routes runs via residential IPs in 7 countries (US, GB, CA, DE, FR, JP, AU); IP type used when proxy is off is undocumented; no per-GB proxy price published; stealth browser_profile and proxy are per-request options.

caveats: A browser has no published vCPU/RAM allocation; $0.12/browser-hour is not a 4/8 VM.
Default browser concurrency 5 cannot meet 50; custom sales limits required.
Model inference is included with Agent steps; do not add it again.
Per-minute price does not establish rounding increment or minimum session bill.
Existing Agent run finishes when Wallet reaches zero, so zero balance is not an immediate kill guarantee.
Native billing cannot be reduced to a 4-vCPU/8-GiB price. No matching engine sizes, by design.
Agent runs default to max 150 steps (1-500 via beta-gated agent_config.max_steps) and a 10-minute run timeout; worst-case default Agent run = 150 x $0.016 = $2.40.
Wallet can go negative: an in-flight Agent run finishes at $0 and new starts return 402 until money is added (example balance $-2.50).

fleet.verification: No card at signup; new accounts get $8 Wallet funds usable for Agent and Browser before adding a card. After that, card + deposit (min $10) required; auto-reload optional after first deposit.
fleet.tiers: PAYG Browser 5 concurrent sessions; Agent 2 concurrent runs. Enterprise custom concurrency/rate limits.
fleet.notes: Default 5 is Browser quota after wallet funding, not 5 free browser sessions. Every requested browser fleet size (10/50/300/1,000) exceeds PAYG limit. No review timing stated.
